from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper in the collection, including its title and the titles of other papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    cited_titles: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of papers in the collection referenced in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated parsing results for all papers in the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
